summary: Mobile Classification Self-Check 3-step wizard rebuild verified against web parity. Inclusive wording, wizard stepper, per-week tile, anchor hints, and interactive band scale testIDs all present in rendered DOM. Web Shift+D + drag-highlight verified by code review only (theme.jsx keydown handler with input/textarea/select/contentEditable guard; ClassificationCheck.jsx onPointerDown/Move drag). One flaky observation during test-run: mass-clicking through 16 questions across step transitions only advanced progress bar to 2 of 16 — likely a test-script race with the DRAFT auto-save/rehydration effect rather than an app bug (manual click-through in prior iterations 359/360 worked end-to-end). Recommend main agent spot-check by manually walking through the 3 steps once.

action_items: Spot-check mobile: complete the 3-step wizard once by hand and confirm the result screen (csc-result) renders with the per-week tile and that tapping csc-scale-3 opens csc-scale-detail. Automation ran into a progress-desync during mass-clicks that likely doesn't repro under real use.
Optional: run web Shift+D shortcut in an /ai-tools/classification-self-check text field to confirm the input-guard prevents accidental toggles while typing.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx is 875 lines — over the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting result-side pieces (BandScale, ResultActions, SavedChecksPanel, AssessorBlock, SaveCheckCard) into /app/mobile/src/components/tools/csc/*.tsx modules to improve readability.

Mobile band-scale uses the legacy onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderMove API which works but is a legacy touch API. For future work, migrate to react-native-gesture-handler for consistent behavior on real devices (web preview is fine).
Web ClassificationCheck.jsx is very large (>1100 lines). Same recommendation to split ProfileHeader/BandScale/WaylySummary/ClassificationComparison/AssessorBlock into a /csc subfolder.
Web Shift+D handler correctly ignores contentEditable + form fields. Consider also skipping when a modal/dialog with role=dialog is open to avoid surprising shortcut behavior mid-flow (nice-to-have).
